note: Keyboard back after a game's message box
changes: Fixed
A GameMaker 8 game that showed a message or asked for text no longer stops responding to the keyboard afterwards, and a second box in a row is shown instead of closing by itself.

note: More games start in the browser
changes: Fixed
Games packed as a self-extracting installer inside a folder, and downloads that hold an old and a new copy of a game, start (the newer copy).
Fixed
Games whose extensions need the Universal C Runtime, read or write the registry, or run a background thread that waits by spinning no longer stop or run slowly.
Fixed
A game that asks the internet for something now gets an answer that the connection failed, as on a computer that is offline, instead of waiting forever.

note: Game dialogs in the page; faster start when signed in
changes: Changed

Messages, questions and text boxes a game opens (common in GameMaker 8 games) appear in the page instead of the browser's own pop-up: they stay in full screen, Enter answers OK or Yes and Esc Cancel or No as on Windows, and the key that closes them no longer reaches the game.
Changed
When you are signed in, your saves are fetched while the game downloads and is prepared, so the game no longer waits on “Getting your saves…” before it starts.

note: Back from playing keeps your filters; more games start
changes: Fixed
Going back from a game to the archive keeps the search, filters, sort and page you had, and returns to your collections or Public Collections if you started the game there.
Fixed
Games whose exe sits in a folder further inside the download (two folders deep, or next to a readme) are found and start.
Fixed
More GameMaker 8 games start in the browser: ones with CleanMem.dll, and GameMaker 8.0 games whose runner keeps its data at a different place in the exe.

note: GameMaker: Studio 2 games play in the browser
changes: Added
GameMaker: Studio 2 games can be played in the browser, both those with the older 32-bit runner and those with the 64-bit one most of them use, with their sound. Mods are not offered for them yet.

note: Choose between account and browser saves; Windows display fix
changes: Added

When your account and this browser have different saves of a game — because this browser never synced with the account, or both changed since — the player asks which saves to play with, showing when each was last saved. Before, saves made in a browser before it was signed in could be replaced by the account's without asking.
Fixed
In Chrome and Edge on Windows the screen sometimes flashed a frame from a moment before (the game itself was where it should be).
Fixed
Games that open GameMaker's own message, question or text boxes no longer freeze in the browser: the box is shown by the browser.

note: Local games, Play on collections, more playable games
changes: Added

Library › Local games: the games you played in the browser are kept in this browser so they start without downloading again. See how much space each takes, and delete the ones you no longer play (their saves stay).
Added
Collection pages (My Collections, Public Collections and shared collections) have a Play button beside each game that runs in the browser.
Fixed
Games made with GameMaker 8.2's extensions (gm82core, gm82net, gm82joy, gm82snd with FMOD) now start in the browser, and so do games that crashed before their first frame on Delphi's string routines.
Fixed
A game shipped as both a Direct3D 8 and a Direct3D 9 build starts its Direct3D 8 build in the browser, and the engine of an archive with several game exes is now recognized.

note: Playing moves to My Content
changes: Changed

Playing is now under My Content in the sidebar: the games you play in the browser, as cards with their screenshots, most recently played first, with the usual filters behind a Filters button. Play one again straight from its card.
Changed
Browse Games is back to its usual layout, filters on the left, and keeps the new Playable in browser filter.

note: Play GameMaker games right in the browser
changes: Added

Play in browser: GameMaker 8 and GameMaker: Studio games hosted on the archive have a new button under Download. The game runs from its own original files, recompiled for the browser by gm-recomp — nothing to install. Esc (which quits most fangames) brings you back here, and F4 switches to full screen.
Added
Mods beside the Play button, chosen per game: Debug mode, GodMode, CrimsonKid, DotKid and DbgHelper.
Added
Keys: while playing, remap any key (say, A and D for left and right) for one game or for all of them. The game itself is not changed.
Added
Your saves stay in the browser, and in your account when you are signed in, so you can carry on from another computer.
Added
Browse Games shows the games you are playing on the left, with their screenshots, and gains a Playable in browser filter. The filters now open from the Filters button.

note: Filter Browse Games by collection, and open any public collection straight in the catalog
changes: Added

Browse Games has a new Collections filter. Add any public collection, or any of your own lists and folders (your main saves included), and each becomes a chip that cycles exactly like a tag: OR → +AND → -NOT. Show only the games in one list, hide everything in another, or combine them — for example, the games in a public needle collection that aren't in your own “cleared” list. Picking a folder covers every list inside it.
Added

The collection picker shows Public Collections and My Collections side by side, with a search box, and stays open so you can add several at once. While one of your own lists is in use as a filter, adding or removing games from it updates the results right away.
Added

Every public collection now has a “Show in Browse Games” button — on its card in the public library and on the collection page — that opens the catalog already filtered to that collection, with every other filter and sort available on top. From the collection page, Back takes you back to it.
Fixed
Reopening the site in a tab where you had last been viewing a shared collection showed “Collection unavailable” instead of the catalog.

note: The light/dark choice is remembered between visits
changes: Fixed

Dark mode no longer resets when you close the tab. The setting was already being saved, but nothing read it back on the next load, so every visit started light again — the archive now opens in whichever theme you left it in.
Changed

The saved theme is applied before the page draws, so returning in dark mode no longer flashes light for a moment while the app starts up. Layout density is restored the same way, and the admin panel keeps inheriting the main site's theme.

note: Public API: full catalog, tag/engine/date endpoints with composable tri-state filters, and links to each game's Delicious Fruit and IWanna Wiki pages
changes: Added
A new /api/all endpoint returns the entire catalog in one request — the archive is now fully readable from outside, with no key and no rate limit.
Added

Three new catalog endpoints: /api/tag and /api/engine list every tag or engine with its game count (or the matching games), and /api/releasedate reports date coverage year by year (or the games inside a period).
Added

Every endpoint now shares one filter vocabulary, so filters combine freely across all of them. Tags and engines are tri-state exactly like the sidebar — require any, require all, or exclude — and date ranges stack the same way, several include periods at once with specific stretches carved back out.
Added

Games now link out to the sites that document them: the detail panel shows a button for the game's Delicious Fruit page and for its IWanna Wiki page. About 12,300 games carry both, matched by cross-referencing the wiki's catalog — matches are only accepted when the title is unambiguous on both sides and the two sites don't name different creators, so a link never points at the wrong game.
Added

API responses carry those upstream links too, alongside the game's engine, release date and its page on this site, and you can filter on them — source=wiki for everything with a wiki entry, source=df&source_not=wiki for the games only Delicious Fruit knows. /api/random can be scoped by any filter, so a roll can be limited to, say, well-rated needle games from a chosen era.
Added
About & Contact now documents the public API: every endpoint, every filter, and runnable examples.
Changed

/api/search accepts the same filters and paging as the rest, and its existing ?q= / ?id= responses are unchanged. A malformed parameter on any endpoint now returns an error message instead of an empty result.

note: Release dates: ~15k games dated from Delicious Fruit, with sorting and a year filter
changes: Added

Games now carry a release date, recovered from Delicious Fruit's release-date search for every DF-listed game (about 15,000 titles); wiki-sourced games use their wiki entry's creation date. Games neither source knows stay undated.
Added

Sort the catalog by release date (newest first), and filter by release period in the sidebar: add any number of date ranges (open-ended allowed) and set each to include or exclude — e.g. show two separate eras at once, or hide everything from a specific stretch.
Added
The game detail panel shows the release date, and the public search API returns it for every dated game.
Added
Newly synced games get their release date automatically within a CI cycle.

note: Submit games by uploading the files directly, plus a copy-link button on shared collections
changes: Added

The submit-game form now takes direct file uploads: switch the download field to “Upload file” and attach the game archive itself (ZIP/RAR/7z/TAR/GZ/EXE, up to 500 MB) with a live progress bar — no file host needed.
Added
Screenshots can be uploaded too (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, up to 8 MB each) straight from the screenshot rows, instead of pasting image links.
Added
Uploaded files are staged securely until review: approved submissions move them into the archive automatically, rejected ones are cleaned up.
Added
Opened shared and public collection pages now have a “Copy link” button, so anyone can share any public collection directly.

note: Collections: folders can go public, author attribution & copy links for public collections
changes: Added

Folders (collections with sub-collections) can now be submitted to the public library. The review covers the whole tree; sub-lists with custom names/descriptions created or renamed after it goes public are held until they pass review.
Added
A “Show my username on the shared page” toggle — on by default for new shares — credits you on shared collections and in the public library. You can switch it any time, even while public.
Added
Approved public collections now show a copy-link button in the edit dialog, so you can share their direct link anywhere.
Added
Shared folders render each sub-collection as its own section, and the manager shows pending/rejected review badges.
Fixed
The edit button icon is now an actual gear instead of a sun-looking glyph.

note: Collections: build lists & folders, save games to several at once, and share them
changes: Added
My Collections now supports multiple named lists plus one level of folders (up to 5 sub-lists each). Your existing bookmarks stay as the pinned “Main saves” bucket.
Added
A per-game “add to collection” menu (beside the bookmark) lets you save a game to several lists at once, create a new list on the spot, and see everywhere it’s already saved.
Added
Rename and describe any collection (with length limits). Name and description are optional at creation.
Added

Share a collection two ways: an instant link (for lists with a blank or preset name and no description), or “Open to public” — reviewed by a moderator, then listed in the new Public Collections library and shareable by link. Public collections lock their name/description; you can still add or remove games.
Added
New Public Collections section in the sidebar to browse community-shared game lists, and a read-only shared-collection page (?collection=…) that opens fast even for signed-out visitors.

note: Game engines: every game shows its engine, and you can filter by it
changes: Added

Every game now displays its game engine — GameMaker 8, GameMaker: Studio, GameMaker: Studio 2, Multimedia Fusion 2, Godot, Unity, Construct, GDevelop, and more — shown below the author on cards, list rows, and the detail drawer.
Added
New Engines filter in the catalog sidebar: narrow the library by one or more engines (with an Unknown bucket), each showing its game count.
Added
Detected and backfilled the engine for 16,500+ games from binary recognition data; the public /api/search response now includes each game's engine.

note: Faster loading, leaner build, and an extended public API
changes: Added
New public endpoint GET /api/random returns one or more random games, with ?count= (1-50, default 1) and an optional ?tag= filter; responses are uncached so each call re-samples.
Added
The public /api/search response now includes each game's rating, difficulty, review count, and file size, alongside the existing title, creator, tags, and download URL.
Changed
Production build now precompiles the JSX with esbuild and ships the production React build instead of transpiling in the browser, significantly cutting cold-load work.
Changed
Catalog data chunks and the search index are now minified, and the catalog chunks are preloaded so the app starts fetching them sooner.
Changed
Trimmed the client hydration path by removing redundant per-load work (an unused in-memory review map, mock datasets, and ~20k per-load localStorage probes) with no change to behavior.
Changed
Hardened the deploy pipeline: serialized scheduled and push-triggered runs to prevent data races, pinned the build/deploy toolchain, and bumped CI to Node 22 (required by Wrangler 4).
Fixed
Local dev server: fixed an UnboundLocalError that broke the local /api/search endpoint.

note: Shareable game links, default sort, and consolidated auth/pipeline fixes
changes: Added
Shareable per-game deep links: opening a game updates the address bar (?game=<id>) via the History API with no reload, and visiting that link opens straight into the game's detail drawer.
Added
Copy-share-link button beside each game title in the detail drawer, with clipboard fallback and a toast confirmation, localized across all 8 languages.
Changed
Default catalog sort is now newest-first by game ID (descending).
Fixed
Restored the Clerk sign-in UI by pinning clerk-js to v5 and loading it from the Frontend API domain so code-split chunks resolve correctly.
Fixed
Memoized Clerk.load() to prevent a UI-wiring race that could no-op the login button.
Changed
Render the logged-in state immediately from the Clerk session without waiting on /api/me.
Fixed
Added the user_favorites table to the D1 schema so the Collections feature no longer errors.
Added
Duplicate-resolution tool to remove or unlink duplicate games across the catalog and R2, with a dry-run safety model and version-delta bookkeeping.
Fixed
De-duplicated the scraped-reviews corpus and hardened the metrics recalc against null download URLs, malformed fields, and deleted (tombstoned) games.
Added
Scraped reviews (including rating-only entries) now sync into D1 so they appear in the game detail drawer.
Fixed
Capture full multi-line review text, retry D1 sync on transient network failures, and avoid duplicate/truncated reviews on re-scrape.

note: Production authentication keys migration and collections stabilization
changes: Changed
Migrated authentication and serverless API integration to production Clerk keys (pk_live/sk_live).
Fixed
Resolved infinite recursion error in catalog by scoping localized translation variables within IIFEs.
Fixed
Synchronized favorites API state changes locally to immediately update bookmark states without page reload.
Fixed
Updated build distribution script to correctly package and cache-bust the new collections component.

note: Cloud-synced favorites bookmarks and collection management
changes: Added
D1 SQL database table user_favorites and unique indexes to store user bookmarks in the cloud.
Added
Serverless API endpoints GET /api/favorites, POST /api/favorites, and DELETE /api/favorites/:id with Clerk validation.
Added
Visual collections card grid view with lazy loading, skeleton states, and empty placeholders.
Added
Interactive bookmark/favorite toggle button in details drawer and on collection grid cards with pop scale animations.
Changed
Upgraded CollectionsView to leverage Favorites API with Clerk session token headers for authorization.
Added
Fully localized 21 new favorites/collections labels across all 8 supported languages.

note: Review options, precision filtering, and profile nickname-only support
changes: Added
Clerk Authentication and Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA integration.
Added
Native comments/reviews section with moderator approval workflow.
Added
Support for dynamic co-creator inputs and custom tags in game submissions.
Added
Enforced strict limits on custom tags (maximum 10 tags per entry, 20 characters per tag).
Added
Optional rating and difficulty independent toggle switches in review editor.
Added
Numeric input boxes for precise range filtering of ratings and difficulty.
Added
Automated R2 mirroring for approved submissions (packages & screenshots) in GitHub Actions deploy pipeline.
Changed
Reconfigured user profile settings to map to a single Nickname field and hide Last Name.
Changed
Decoupled Clerk authentication loading and parallelized database downloads to optimize cold load speeds.
Fixed
Resolved auth redirect flow state loss using sessionStorage to restore UI drawer viewport state.
Removed
Operator filter and column in the Admin Portal audit logs table.
Added
Full multi-language support (i18n) for 8 languages (en, zh-CN, zh-TW, ja, ko, ru, fr, de) with automatic detection based on browser language and manual toggle dropdown in top bar.
Removed
Obsolete and unused administrative files: health.jsx and crawler.jsx.

note: Refactor unrated metrics and layout improvements
changes: Refactored
Represent unrated ratings and difficulties as null in memory to differentiate from true zero scores.
Fixed
Pre-nullify unrated metrics during database chunking to resolve unrated games displaying 0.0 on the catalog.
Added
Custom sort and filter logic in the catalog to push unrated games to the bottom and filter them accurately.
Added
Prefix review ratings with 'rating' label inside the game details panel comments section.
Fixed
Exclude unrated difficulty values from playlist average difficulty calculations.

note: Update Log timeline & versioning
changes: Added
New Update Log section with timeline visualization.
Added
Separate application versioning scheme (Year.xxx) to track content releases.

note: Public launch
changes: Added
Initial public release of the standalone Fangame Archive catalog.
